s : { heading: s.heading, span: { start: carry, end: s.span.end } });\n    carry = null;\n  }\n  if (carry !== null) {\n    const last = out[out.length - 1];\n    if (last) out[out.length - 1] = { heading: last.heading, span: { start: last.span.start, end: text.length } };\n    else out.push({ heading: '', span: { start: carry, end: text.length } });\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\n/**\n * Остання межа у вікні — але лише в його другій половині: інакше розділ на\n * 1200 символів різався б після першого ж абзацу на 40 символів.\n */\nfunction lastBoundary(window: string, re: RegExp): number | null {\n  let found: number | null = null;\n  for (const m of window.matchAll(re)) found = (m.index ?? {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1795694484913,"sessionID":"ses_de8454a1cffevh0BziBeHAtOES","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"zvkswFGOc7usxwHJ","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/Users/lizaefremenko/Desktop/IT STEP/AI/harness-runs/B-strong/t-13-1795694437810/tests/chunk-stats.test.ts","content":"import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nimport type { Chunk } from '../src/rag/chunk';\nimport { chunkStats } from '../src/rag/chunk';\n\nfunction createChunk(text: string, id: string): Chunk {\n  return {\n    id,\n    docId: 'doc-1',\n    heading: '',\n    start: 0,\n    end: text.length,\n    text,\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('chunkStats', () => {\n  it('повертає нулі для порожнього масиву', () => {\n    expect(chunkStats([])).toEqual({ count: 0, avgChars: 0, maxChars: 0 });\n  });\n\n  it('три фрагменти довжиною 10, 20 і 25 символів дають { count: 3, avgChars: 18, maxChars: 25 }', () => {\n    const chunks: Chunk[] = [\n      createChunk('a'.repeat(10), 'chunk-1'),\n      createChunk('b'.repeat(20), 'chunk-2'),\n      createChunk('c'.repeat(25), 'chunk-3'),\n    ];\n    expect(chunkStats(chunks)).toEqual({ count: 3, avgChars: 18, maxChars: 25 });\n  });\n});\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/Users/lizaefremenko/Desktop/IT STEP/AI/harness-runs/B-strong/t-13-1795694437810/tests/chunk-stats.test.ts","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tests/chunk-stats.test.ts","time":{"start":1795694484908,"end":1795694484912}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_217bb5da8001p4CM2px7lM3KfX","sessionID":"ses_de8454a1cffevh0BziBeHAtOES","messageID":"msg_217bb4db0001DmbxW6rttdSpu0"}}
